answer: Require each agent to anchor its identity to one vault deposit locked for a fixed period and tied to a single verifiable history of completed work. A newcomer can join, but it cannot borrow another agent's record or split one deposit across many names. An attacker who wants a hundred fake identities must therefore fund a hundred separate deposits and wait out a hundred lock periods, like crossing a tundra on foot with supplies for each traveller, while honest agents keep working with the one identity they already maintain.
